Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase! The South African players make their way out to the middle. They are followed by the Pakistan openers, Fakhar Zaman and Imam Ul-Haq. Kagiso Rabada to begin. Here we go...

So a big target is what Pakistan have to chase! They need all their batters to come good. The wicket is a good one but South Africa will be up for this as it is a must-win game for them. So what will it be. 1-1 or 2-0? We will find out...

The Pakistan bowling was not at its best here! There quite a few lose deliveries and that did not help their cause. Faheem and Rauf were really good! Faheem did take a pounding at the end but was excellent in his initial spells. Rauf was excellent throughout but lacked support from the other bowlers.

De Kock perished but Rassie and Bavuma continued the good work. The two added another 50-run stand before the centurion of the last game departed. Bavuma was all set to get a ton before he held out. South Africa did slow down as they kept losing wickets at regular intervals but some meaty blows from Miller at the end has taken them to a total which is above par.

End of a strong batting display by South Africa! Their skipper will be very pleased with where they stand in the game after being inserted! It was their openers who get them off to a good start before Markram fell. However, de Kock and Bavuma then added 100-plus and laid the foundation for a big score.

Yes he can! That is FIFTY for Miller and a very good one too! Low full toss and he heaves it wide of long on and picks up a couple. A great innings by Miller and he has powered his team to a massive total of 341!
Length ball on middle. Miller miscues it to deep mid-wicket and takes a couple. Can he get to his fifty?

FOUR! POWER! Nothing really wrong with the ball gets a boundary! Full ball on off. Miller gets under it and creams it to the sweeper cover fence. The man at deep put in a dive but it was struck too firmly.
SIX! MASSIVE! Slower ball by Afridi, Miller picks it up early and deposits it into the stands at deep mid-wicket.
FOUR! This is great by Miller! He backed away to the leg side but Afridi followed him with a length. He opened the face of the bat and slices it over point for a boundary.
Yorker! Right in the block hole. Raba looks to go down the ground but gets the inside edge to short fine leg. Miller is back on strike.

OUT! TAKEN! Great end to a very good spell from Rauf! Short and wide outside off. Andile looks to cut it away but only manages a thick edge towards third man. Faheem Ashraf takes a good catch to complete the wicket.
Excellent by Rauf! Saw Andile back away to the off side and followed him with a length ball. Andile Phehlukwayo looks to lap it over the keeper but misses.
The plan of bowling full to Miller seems to be working! Low full toss on his pads and it is drilled to deep mid-wicket for one.
Short one this time! On his body and Andile goes for the pull, he doesn't middle it and the ball goes to deep-midwicket on the bounce.
Good bowling! Full ball, on middle and off. Middle doesn't get under it and drills it to long on for one.
Short and wide outside off. Andile cuts it to point and gets Miller back on strike.
Greets him with a yorker outside off and Andile Phehlukwayo hits it past covers to get off the mark. 11 and a wicket from the over.

OUT! TAKEN! WHAT A CATCH BY RAUF! Low full toss, outside off. Klassen looks to hit it over short fine leg. He connects well and the ball is travelling. Haris Rauf is the man at short fine leg and he plucks the ball out of the air. A great catch to bring Klassen's stay to an end.
FOUR! Great shot! Low full toss on the stumps and he manages to slog it to the mid-wicket fence.
Full one on the pads. Klassen looks to flick it but misses.
FOUR! No stopping this one! Length ball in the slot and he hits it over the mid off fielder and to the ropes. Powerful stroke.
Brilliant effort in the deep. Short ball and Klassen nails the pull shot. The ball is rolling away to mid-wicket fence but the fielder dives in and saves a couple.
Just a single! A brilliant over! Two runs and a wicket from it. On middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for one.
BEATEN! Yet another dot! Shorter and outside off, Klaasen looks to cut but misses.
On off, this is pushed to covers.
Shorter and on off, Klaasen looks to cut but misses.

OUT! TAKEN! Heartbreak for Bavuma as he falls 8 short of a ton! He had played really well and deserved one. A short one from Rauf. Bavuma looks to pull but hits it flat and straight to the man at deep mid-wicket who makes no mistake. The bounce did him in here. Also, he picked the longer part of the ground.
A single as this is pushed trhough covers.
Outside off, this is hit through covers for one.
Full and on off, Bavuma looks to flick but gets an inside edge onto the pads. It rolls on the off side for one.
Just a single! Full and outside off, this is hit through covers for one.
Straight to the fielder this time! Fuller and on off, it is hit hard but to covers.

SIX! This is right off the middle! This is huge. This is maximum punishment. A biggie on the no ball and now a biggie on the Free Hit as well. 300 up. Shorter and on middle, this is heaved over the mid-wicket fence for a biggie.
SIX! AND IT IS A NO BALL! Miller steps out, it is banged in short. Miller hammers it well over the square leg fence for a biggie. Free Hit coming up.
Shorter and on the body, Miller pulls it, it goes off the top end towards square leg for two.
Just 5 from the over, a good over in this situation. Short and wide outside off. Miller cuts it to sweeper cover. Just one run taken.
Beaten! Comes around the wicket and lands it on a length, the ball nips back in and cramps Miller for any room. Miller looks to cut it but the ball goes past his bat.
Slower one this time. On middle and leg, Bavuma clips it to mid-wicket for one.
Effort ball from Hasnain! He runs in and digs this one short outside off. Bavuma lets it go.
Short and wide outside off. Cut straight to covers.
Great work to save a run! Length ball on the pads and Miller flicks it to the deep backward sqaure leg fence.The ball is rolling away but the fielder runs in, dives and saves a run.
Brillant by Afridi! Another full one on middle and Bavuma jabs it back to Afridi. He dives to his right to stop it, then tries to hit the stumps at his end but misses. Just 3 from the over.
A touch shorter, outside off. Miller pulls but to deep mid-wicket.
Excellent by Afridi! Fires a yorker, right in the block hole. Miller can only hit it to mid off.
Full one, outside off. Bavuma looks to go inside out but the ball goes to sweeper cover on the bounce.
Length ball, on his pads. Miller clips it to deep square leg for one.
Good bowling! Fires a full one on the stumps and Miller digs it back to the bowler.
Geez that sounded good! Short ball outside off and he nails the pull shot to deep mid-wicket.
FOUR! Smashed by Miller the Killer! Full ball outside off and he smashes it to the cover fence. The man in the ring dived to stop it but it was hit too well.
Full ball, outside off. Miller punches it down the ground but Rauf gets his hands to it.
A touch fuller this time, on the fourth stump line. Bavuma taps it towards backward point and rotates the strike.
A touch shorter this time, on his body and Miller flicks it down to deep backward square leg for one.
Serves a length ball, touch outside off. Pushed to covers by Miller.
Off the mark straightaway! Length ball, outside off. Miller hangs back and runs it down to third man for one. 13 runs and a big wicket from the over.
Back of a length, around off and pushed to mid on for a run.

OUT! TAKEN! Big, Big wicket for Pakistan! The in-form and dangerous Rassie van der Dussen is gone! Length ball, right in the slot and he looks to go over long on. He doesn't middle and ends up hitting it straight to Faheem Ashraf at long on. End of a very entertaining innings by Rassie. He has set the stage for a big total.
FOUR! Too easy for Rassie! Not a terrible delivery but he gets a boundary! Full ball, almost a yoker on the pads and he flicks it to the fine leg fence.
SIX! Wow! Powerful stroke! Short ball outside off, he swivels across and pulls it to the mid-wicket fence. It the short boundary and the ball goes over easily.
Fuller baol, around off and clipped to deep sqaure leg for one.
FOUR! Splits the gap and gets to his fastest ODI FIFTY! Tossed up delivery, on his pads and he sweeps it to the mid-wicket fence.
Loopy ball, pushed to deep cover for one.
Tossed up on middle, clipped to deep mid-wicket for one.

NOT OUT! The ball is missing and Rassie is safe! Flatter ball on middle and leg. Rassie attempts his third reverse sweep of the over but misses. He is hit on the pads, the ball rolls away and they take one. Pakistan is interested in LBW but the umpire is unmoved. Pakistan review at the last second. Ultra Edge shows nothing but Ball Tracker shows that it was missing the off pole.
Review time right at the end! An appeal for LBW has been turned down. It is reviewed. Height is an issue.
Four!
Full ball on middle, Rassie brings the reverse sweep but straight to point.
Powerplay 3 has been signaled! Now 5 fielders can be placed outside the ring till the end of the innings.
Another end of a huge over! On middle, this is worked through fine leg for two.
FOUR! Runs are flowing at the moment! This is shorter and outside off. Bavuma slaps it through point. Races away to the fence.
Outside off, this is cut, but to point.
Miscue but one! Shorter and on off, Rassie swings, he looks to drag it but it goes off the bottom towards deep mid-wicket for one.
Shorter and outside off, Rassie guides it to point.
SIX! It is all too easy for South Africa right now! This is right in the slot. Full and on middle, Rassie heaves it well over the mid-wicket fence. Once again a biggie to start the over.
Mohammad Hasnain (7-0-43-0) will bowl now.
A single to end! On off, it is pushed through covers for one.
Slows it up and lands it on off, blocked.
FOUR! Short ball and hammered! On middle, Rassie rocks back and hammers it through square leg.
A single now! On middle, it is worked to mid-wicket.
On off, it is pushed towards point.
FOUR! In the gap! Beautiful! Fuller and on middle, Bavuma strokes it through covers. Races away for another boundary.
Shadab Khan (7-0-42-0) is back into the attack.

SIX! All the way! Once again the last ball costs Pakistan! It is short and a slower one. Outside off. Rassie hops and slaps it over the point fence for a biggie. 50-run stand up. Another good one for South Africa.
Fuller and on middle, this is worked through square leg for one.
On the bounce! On the shorter side, this is pulled hard but on the bouce to the fielder at deep mid-wicket. For one.
Another single! On the shorter side, this is pulled through mid-wicket for one more.
Just a single again! On off, it is pushed towards cover for one.
Goes shorter and outside off, Bavuma drags it towards mid-wicket for one.
Well fielded and a dot to end! So despite the boundary, just the 5 from it. On off, it is pushed towards cover where Shadab dives to his left and stops it.
Sees the batter come down the track and bowls it short. Defended.
FOUR! Over the point fielder! The reverse sweep is out this time, he nails it over the point fielder for a boundary.
Fired on middle, Rassie pushes it back to the bowler.
On middle, Bavuma plays the paddle sweep towards short fine leg for one.
Close! Shortish and closer to the off pole. Bavuma goes back and looks to push at it but misses. Goes close past the off pole.
Slower short ball, this is slapped through covers for one. A good over for South Africa.
Brilliant running! Fuller and on off, Bavuma drives it through covers. The fielder there gets a hand to it. Bavuma takes one and goes for the second. Completes it.
A single now! Outside off, this is pushed through covers for one.
Just the single again! Both are going for it now! Bavuma moves across now, this is banged in short. It is pulled towards square leg for one.
Rassie once again shuffles across, this is shorter again, Rassie swings again but it hits the glove and lobs towards square leg for one.

SIX! That has cleared the fence! The 200 is up in style! This is shorter and on middle, Rassie shuffles across and pulls it. It hits the higher part of the bat but goes over the square leg fence. Pressure on the bowler now.
Loopy delivery, around off. Bavuma lunges forward and defends it.
FOUR! Brillant from the skipper! Great execution! Tossed up on off, Bavuma had already made up his mind to play the reverse sweep. He connects and the ball goes past short third man for a boundary.
Shorter but no real width on it. Bavuma goes for the cut but gets the inside edge on his boots.
Flatter ball, outside off. Rassie pushes it to long off for a run.
Short and wide outside off. Bavuma cuts it to deep cover for one.
Tossed up, around off and defended.
Danish Aziz is introduced into the attack.
Extra bounce there! It lands on a length and takes off. Rassie takes his bottom hand off the handle at the last moment to protect it.
Hits the deck on a length, outside off and Rassie defends it well.
Length ball, around off and it is hit back to Ashraf.
A fuller ball this time, outside off. Rassie leans in and pushes it to covers.
The phsio is out as Rassie is hit on the elbow. The magic spray will be used.

Length ball, outside off. Rassie looks to defend it but is hit on the elbow. The ball rolls away and Bavuma looks for a run but is sent back by Rassie. The man at short third man has a shy at the bowler's end but misses.
Starts with a full ball, on middle. Clipped away to deep mid-wicket. Single taken.
Faheem Ashraf will have a go at the batters now.
Length ball, lands outside off and nips back in. Rassie defends it. 10 runs of the over.
A touch fuller, but wide outside off. Tempting for Rassie but he shoulders his arms.
Slower one this time, outside off. Bavuma taps it to the off side and takes a run.
FOUR! Two in a row! Brillant placement! Short ball on off and he pulls it to deep sqaure leg fence.
FOUR! Beautiful stroke and a wonderful way to get his FIFTY! Full ball on middle and he flicks it past mid on and to the ropes.
Length ball, around off. Flicked to deep square leg for one.

With that, the umpires have called for drinks. Pakistan would be quite happy at the moment as they have sent the dangerous Quinton de Kock back in the hut. South Africa need Rassie van der Dussen to carry on his good form and build a solid partnership with skipper Bavuma.
Tossed up, outside off and Bavuma offers a solid defence. Shadab Khan is keeping things tight here.
A touch fuller this time, Bavuma leans and defends it.
Loppy ball on off and driven to long off for one.
Floated outside off and Bavuma pushes it to long off for one.
Loopy ball, outside off. It is pushed past point for one.
FOUR! Brilliant timing on that one! Tossed up, outside off. Rassie leans into it and drives it to deep cover fence.
Full ball, on the pads and Bavuma clips it to deep mi-wicket for a couple. Good over for Pakistan, a wicket and 3 runs off it.
Fuller ball, on off and defended by Bavuma.
Swing and a miss! Length ball, lands outside off and shapes away a bit. Bavuma goes for the flashy drive but is beaten.
Length ball on his pads and Rassie clips it to square leg to get off the mark.
Doesn't carry to the keeper! Length ball, outside off and Rassie van der Dussen pokes at it. He gets a outside edge but it falls just short of the keeper.
Rassie van der Dussen is the new man in.

OUT! BOWLED! There it is! There is breakthough that Pakistan wanted! Rauf strikes immediately! Serves a length ball outside off. De Kock tries to show him who the boss is by hitting it out of here. But only manages an inside edge on the off pole. A very patient innings and a solid partnernship has been broken.
Haris Rauf is back into the attack.
FOUR! And once again, the last ball spoils the over. This is shorter and outside off, it is cut through point. The fielder in the deep runs to his left, dives to his left but fails to stop it.
On middle, this is pushed down to long on for one.
This time does drive it through covers but only one.
Floats it up nice and slow outside off. Bavuma looks to drive but misses.
The reverse sweep is out. It is mistimed towards short third man for one.
Very full and on middle, this is jammed towards mid on. The fielder at mid-wicket runs to his left and dives, pushes it away but it is just a single.
Solid stroke but for no runs! Fuller and around off, de Kock hits it nicely but to covers.
Misses out there! This is a full toss on off, it is driven to mid off.

FOUR! Consecutive boundaries now! This is full and outside off. De Kock looks to drive but it goes off the outside edge and down to the third man fence. Not where de Kock intended it to go but he won't mind.

FOUR! The 100-run stand is up and in style! It has not been the most free-flowing partnership but a good one. This is fuller and on middle, de Kock whips it over the mid-wicket fielder and into the fence.
On the bounce! Shorter and on middle, Bavuma plays the upper cut. Not off the middle, it goes towards third man for one.
WIDE! Angles this down the leg side from around the wicket. Wided.
Shorter and outside off, Bavuma hops and looks to cut but gets an underedge to point.
On middle, this is hit down to long on for another single. A decent over by Shadab.
Floats it up on off, defended.
Quick run! On the pads, this is worked towards short fine leg for one.
Tossed up nicely and on middle, it is worked to mid-wicket.
Fuller and on middle, this is hit hard back towards the bowler. It hits the foot of the umpire and goes down to long on for one.
Tossed up on off, Bavuma pushes it to covers.
One more single and that is 8 from the over. Length and on off, it is pushed through covers.
A single now to follow the boundary! Good batting as this is worked towards square leg.
FOUR! Up and over! Clever shot! The fine leg is inside the ring. De Kock shuffles across and paddle scoops it over the fielder there for another boundary.
Good length and on off, Bavuma drops it towards point and takes one.
A slower bumper, Bavuma evades it. It bounces just in front of Rizwan who makes a half stop. No run taken.
Good length and on off, this is guided down to third man for one.
Shaheen Afridi (5-1-24-0) is back into the attack.
FOUR! Slightly short and put away! Bavuma rocks back quickly and pulls it over mid-wicket. No one in the deep so a boundary results. Once again we see the last ball spoiling the over.
Another single as de Kock works it through mid-wicket for one.
On middle, this is pushed down to long on for one.
Shorter and on middle, this is pulled through square leg for one.
De Kock steps out. Shadab slows it up and bowls it on the pdas. Quinton swings but it goes off the inner half towards short fine leg.
On off, this is played towards point for one. Good batting by Bavuma.
FOUR! The boundary spoils the over! Length ball, plenty of width outside off and de Kock creams it through the covers and into the fence.
Tap and run! Length ball on off and Bavuma taps it to the off side for one.
A touch short this time, outside off. De Kock runs it to third man for a run.
Length ball on middle and Bavuma clips it towards mid-wicket. The fielder dives to keep it down to one.
He misses out on that one, does de Kock! Length ball on the pads and he looks to deposit it in the stands. He doesn't connect and the ball takes the thigh guard to square leg for one.
Good length ball, on middle and Bavuma clips it to mid-wicket to get his partner on strike.
Loopy ball, outside off. De Kock comes down the track but hits it to mid off.
Tossed up on middle, clipped to the leg side for one.

Nearly Chopped on! Loopy ball on the leg stump. De Kock looks to lap it down the leg side but the ball hits the back of the his. The ball kissed the stumps but the zing bails didn't come off. It rolls past the keeper and they take one.
A touch shorter this time, outside off. De Kock clips it to silly mid on.
Fuller one on middle and pushed down to long on for one.
Tossed up on off and Bavuma pushes it to covers. He looks for a run and is outside the crease, de Kock sends him back and he makes it back in time.
A touch shorter and wide outside off. Bavuma gets on top of the bounce and punches it to deep cover. Single taken.
Length ball, outside off. De Kock looks to pull it away but doesn't middle it. The ball goes to deep square leg and they take a run.
Good length ball, around off and de Kock defends this one.
FOUR! He is looking to maka a move now! A length ball right in the slot and de Kock smacks it past the bowler and to the long off fence.
Full ball on off, Bavuma shimmies down and clips it to mid-wicket for one.
Almost chopped on! Length ball, too close to the off stumps but Bavuma looks to run it to third man. He gets the inside egde but it rolls past the stumps.
Reverse sweep but straight to the fielder! Tossed up ball on middle and de Kock goes for the reverse sweep but hits it to short third man.
A touch shorter this time, around middle. De Kock goes back and clips it to short fine leg.
A fuller one this time, pushed to long on for one.
FOUR! Great use of the feet! Tossed up on middle, Bavuma shimmies and gets to the pitch of the ball to flick it to the mid-wicket fence.
FIFTY for de Kock and very patient one! Tossed up on middle and he clips it to mid-wicket for one.
Tossed up on off. De Kock looks to defend but gets the outside edge to short third man.
Hits the deck on a length, on middle and leg. Bavuma looks to glance it away but misses and is hit high on the pads. Good over for Pakistan.
Lands a length ball, around off. Defended by Bavuma.
Short and wide outside off. Bavuma cuts it to the point fence, but the fielder runs and dives to his left to keep it down to two.
A touch fuller this time, outside off. De Kock pushes it to deep cover and brings up the 50 partnership between the two.
Good length ball, outside off. De Kock looks to cut but fails to get bat on it.
Cuts him in half! Lands it on a length outside off and the ball nips back in with the angle. De Kock looks to cut it but the ball jags back in sharply and goes through the gate.
The googly to end! It lands on off, Bavuma blocks it nicely. So a good comeback after going for a boundary early on.
One more single as de Kock now eases it down to long on.
Shorter and on off, this is pushed down to long on for one.
On middle, this is worked towards mid-wicket for one.
Going over! Te extra bounce saves de Kock here. It lands on middle, de Kock goes for the reverse sweep again but it hits the higher part of the bat. A huge appeal but turned down.
FOUR! The reverse sweep and it is put away! Not letting the bowler settle. Plays it nicely, rolls his wrists over the ball and hits it through point for a boundary.
Drop and run! On off, de Kock plays it towards point and gets to the other end.
Another one on middle, Bavuma works it towards mid on and takes a quick run.
Length and on off, Bavuma pushes it to covers.
WIDE! Very short and outside off, Bavuma lets it go over him.
Just a single now! On middle, it is worked towards mid-wicket for one.
That is outstanding from Faheem! Wow! This is shorter and outside off, de Kock guides it past point. It seems to be racing away but Faheem runs to his left, dives and saves two for his side.
Leading edge but safe! This is a slower one, angles it into the pads. De Kock closes the face of the bat early. He gets a soft leading edge to the right of the fielder.
7 from the over then! De Kock steps out! The length is shortened. It is guided down to third man for one.
Solid! Good length and on off, de Kock plays it back to the bowler.
Superb fielding! Shorter and outside off, de Kock cuts but Imam at point dives to his right and stops it.
Another single! Bavuma shuffles right across and works this towards mid-wicket.
Now a single! On the pads, this is worked through square leg for one.
FOUR! BANGED AWAY! De Kock now finds the fence. Consecutive boundaries! This one is slightly short and outside off, de Kock pulls it hard through mid-wicket. Races away.

FOUR! That should release the pressure that was building on Bavuma! Not a good ball, it is sliding onto the pads, Bavuma works it through mid-wicket and it races away. Rauf is not happy and rightly so. It spoils the over some what.
One more single! Outside off, de Kock guides it down to third man and gets to the other end.
Gets off strike this time! Shorter and on the body, this is worked down to fine leg for one.
Make that three dots in a row! On middle, Bavuma works it to mid-wicket.
Another dot! On off, Bavuma plays it to mid on. Something is going to happen here, a big shot coming we feel.
Back of a length and on off, this one stays a touch low. Bavuma defends it.
A dot to end then! Really full and on off, it is jammed down to mid off. Another tidy over from Faheem.

Really nicely played in the end! Bavuma takes a few steps ahead and Faheem bowls it shortish and around off. This one takes off after landing. Bavuma does well to play it with soft hands down towards third man for one.

DRINKS! In the meantime, the umpires have planned to take a break! Good going from South Africa so far. They are batting quite sensibly. De Kock looks set for a big innings and Bavuma has been solid so far. Need the two to go on. Pakistan on the other hand, have also been decent, they have managed to pull things back well after the start the hosts' openers got them off too. They need wickets though or will be chasing a big total. Can they get it? We will find out.
The back of the bat has been broken! Length and on off, Bavuma defends it and off comes a part of his bat. Change of bats for him please.
On middle, giving no room to the batter. It is pushed back to the bowler.
Very well fielded! Length and on off, it is pushed towards cover. He wants a run but is sent back. The fielder there dives to his left and stops it. Has a shy at the keeper's end but misses.
Shorter in length, de Kock pulls it towards the longer part of the ground, he does so all along the ground through mid-wicket for one.
Back of a length, on the fourth stump line. Bavuma defends. Just 4 runs from the over.
Comes around the wicket and lands it on a length, on middle and off. Clipped towards deep square leg for ine.
Tap and run! A touch shorter this time, around off. Bavuma taps it towards mid off and rotates the strike.
Serves a length ball, just outside off. Bavuma stands up and pushes it to covers.
A touch fuller, around off. De Kock covers his stumps and clips it to deep mid-wicket. Single taken.
Rauf digs this one short and outside off. Bavuma hops up and plays it past point for a run.
A touch fuller this time, on middle and leg. Bavuma pushes it to mid on and takes off for a run. The fielder throws at the bowler's end but misses.
Good length ball, lands on off and nips back in a bit. Bavuma defends.
Good bowling by Ashraf. Lands it right in the corridor of uncertainty. Bavuma covers his stumps and lets it go.
Fuller delivery, around off. Bavuma offers a solid defence.
A touch shorter this time, around middle and off. De Kock shuffles across and clips it to square leg for a run.
Hits the deck on a length, the ball lands outside off and angles further away. De Kock looks to offer a stroke but abandons in the end.
Fuller this time, on middle and defended. 11 from the over.
Length ball, around middle. De Kock clips it past square leg for one.

FOUR! Not where he wanted to hit that, but gets four runs! Short ball, outside off. De Kock looks to pull it away but gets the thick outside egde. The ball travels over the leaping first slip and to the ropes.
Beaten! Length ball, wide outside off. He goes for the cut but is beaten.
SIX! Connects this time and gets the desired result! A touch shorter, on off and de Kock pulls it toward the backward square leg fence for a maximum. That will release the pressure that was building.
Length ball, outside off. De Kock pushes it past point, but the fielder puts in a good dive to stop it.
Fuller this time, on the pads and clipped past square leg for one.
Length ball, on middle and defended.

It hit the thigh pad so de Kock is NOT OUT! IT IS OFF THE THIGH PAD! Beauty by Ashraf but de Kock is safe! Length ball, lands on middle and then nips away. De Kock looks to defend it but is beaten! The ball is flying to the right of Shadab at first slip, he dives and catches it. Pakistan appeal and it is given by the umpire. De Kock reviews it and does so successfuly.  The ball had hit the thigh pad and the review is retained.
EDGED AND TAKEN! Or is it? De Kock has been given out but he reviews. So that might not be off the bat.
1 run.
Good length ball, outside off and Bavuma lets it go.
Hits the deck on a length, outside off. Bavuma shimmies down the track but leaves it in the end.
Good length ball, outside off and de Kock pushes it to covers.
Beaten! Sharp bowling! Short ball around off, de Kock looks to pull it away but is beaten for pace. The ball goes back to the keeper.

A strong appeal Rauf but de Kock is not out! Length ball, on middle. De Kock looks to pull it away but is beaten for pace. The ball hits the thigh pad and lobs up to point. Rauf thinks he got an inside edge but the umpire is unmoved.
Short and wide outside off. De Kock thinks of cutting it away but ends up pushing it to covers.
A back of a length ball, drifting on the pads and Bavuma clips down to fine leg for one.
Length ball, on off. Bavuma defends it off the back foot.
End of Powerplay 1. Now four fielders can be outside the ring till the 40th over. Haris Rauf comes on to bowl.
Bavuma is off the mark! Outside off, it is guided down to third man for one. End of Powerplay 1 and a good one for South Africa! They are 56 for 1 after it.
Shorter and outside off, Bavuma looks to cut but is beaten by the extra bounce.
Good length and on off, defended.
Temba Bavuma, the South African skipper, walks out to bat!

OUT! TAKEN! Rizwan will now breathe a sigh of relief as Markram departs! Once again he throws away a start! He just continued to go hard and that has cost him his wicket. He is gutted with himself and rightly so. This shot was not needed. It is a length ball outside off. Markram looks to slap it on the up but gets it on the higher part of the bat and goes towards covers. Ali takes it nicely. A welcome wicket for Pakistan as this stand was moving along smoothly. The move to get Faheem on has worked. Can Pakistan get things under their control now.

SIX! That is some way to bring the fifty up! What a hit! Wow! He also holds the pose for the cameras! This is slightly fuller and outside off. Markram lofts it with ease and clears the cover fence. That dropped chance is going to cost Pakistan big here.
Length and just outside off, Markram leaves it alone.
Faheem is on now!

FOUR! One brings two and that is exactly the case for de Kock! He has started off slowly but now is getting into his own! This is fuller and around off, de Kock drives it through extra cover. Another boundary. So back-to-back good overs for South Africa.
FOUR! Up and over! This is right in the arc for de Kock and he puts it away. Full and on middle, de Kock lofts it over mid on for a boundary. South Africa will hope this gets him going.
Really full this time and on off, de Kock jams it out towards mid off.
Angled in on middle, de Kock works it to square leg. De Kock is happy to play second fiddle here. Good batting by him.
Shuffles right across his stumps this time, Shaheen bowls it fuller and on off. It is worked wide of mid on who runs to his right and stops it nicely. A single.
Back of a length and on off, Markram defends it onto the ground.
A dot to end a very good over for South Africa! On middle, this is worked to mid on.

EDGED AND PUT DOWN! Not sure if Rizwan needed to go after that one. It was going straight to Shadab at first slip! This could well prove a costly drop as Markram is looking in fine touch. Length and around off, it is shaping away. Markram goes after it. Not enough room to slash at it. It goes off the outside edge to the right of Rizwan who dives, it does not stick in his webbing and goes behind for a single.

FOUR! Creamed! Shot of the game so far! This is fuller and around off, Markram leans into it and strokes it wide of mid off and it races away. He just used the pace there. Did not look to hit it very hard.
This time he looks to hit the ball really hard! It is full and outside off, Markram goes after it. It goes off the inner half through square leg for two.
FOUR! Width on offer and put away! Markram looks in really good touch here. This is there to be hit, it is wide outside off. Markram hits it through covers for a boundary.
Fuller and shaping away. Markram lets it go to the keeper.

Yes, it is! First of the game! Angled into the pads, de Kock works it to square leg. De Kock has started off cautiously. Probably he has learnt from his last game that he need not go hard at every ball.
Really full this time and on off, it is jammed out towards cover. 5 dots in a row, can this be a maiden?
Slashes and misses! Another dot! Shorter and outside off, not very short. De Kock looks to cut but the ball sneaks under his bat. Not quite the right length to play that shot.
De Kock misses out there! This is wide outside off, asking to be hit. De Kock slashes at it. It goes off the inner half back to the bowler. He is looking to hit the ball really hard.
Well bowled again! Goes wide of the crease and attacks the stumps. It is on a length. Blocked.
Back of a length and on off, de Kock hangs back and plays it onto the ground.
Finishes the over well! Just the one from it. Fuller and on off, Markram looks to drive but it goes off the inner half towards mid on.
That is a beauty of a nut! Wow! This lands on off, it is shaping away. Markram looks to defend but is beaten. It goes past the edge by a long way but still is a lovely delivery.
On the fuller side this time, looking to move it away from off but there is not swing. It goes off the inner half towards mid on.
And again! Length and just outside off, shaping away. Markram lets it be.
Slightly fuller and just outside off, left alone. Just where the Pakistan bowlers need to be.
Shorter and on the body, that keeps rising on the batter. De Kock looks to nudge it on the leg side but it hits the glove and goes towards fine leg for one.
Length ball, sliding on his pads. De Kock clips it past square leg and will keep the strike.
Brilliant by Afridi! Lands a yorker right on the base of the stumps. De Kock can only block this one.
Too full again, this one lands around middle. Markram looks to play it to the on side but his bat turns in his hands. The ball goes past mid off and they take three.
Full ball on middle. Markram times it well down the ground, but mid on runs to his left to stop it.
A touch fuller, on the pads and Markram clips this nicely past mid-wicket for a couple.
Length ball, outside off. De Kock looks to play it through the off side but gets an inside edge past the stumps. A single is taken.

SIX! Enough of blocking and leaving says Markram! Hasnain drops his length and bowls a short one on off. Markram stands tall and hits a flat six towards the mid-wicket fence. First of the game and the last ball somewhat spoils the over.
Hits the deck on a length, the ball lands outside off and shapes away further. Markram won't chase that one.
A good length delivery, on the fourth stump line. Played towards point.
Lovely shape on that one! A fuller delivery, it lands outside off and nips away sharply. Markram shoulders his arms.
Length delivery, on middle and leg. Markram defends it from the crease.
Lands it on a length, on middle. De Kock takes a couple of steps down, probably to counter the swing and clips it to mid-wicket for one.
Fuller this time, but outside off and left alone.
Good length ball, on the pads and Markram clips it to deep mid-wicket for a couple.
Some swing there! Full ball, lands on middle. Markram looks to play it through the on side but the ball nips away a bit and takes the outer half of the bat to mid off.
Length ball, outside off and Markram leaves it alone.

Direct hit but safe! Length ball on the pads, Markram looks to flick it away but gets an inside edge on his pads. The ball rolls towards short mid-wicket. He sets off for a run but is sent back by de Kock. The fielder makes a direct hit at the striker's stumps but he is in.
Good running between the wickets! Length ball, on middle and de Kock clips it on the leg side and takes off for a run.
Serves a length ball, outside off and Markram leaves it alone.
Wide! Short and wide outside off. Left alone by Markram and the umpire shoulders his arms too.
FOUR! Poor ball and punished! Great timing on that one! Length ball, on his pads and Markram clips it to the deep mid-wicket fence. It was a perfect delivery for de Kock but too straight for Markram.
A touch fuller this time, a bit too straight as well. Flicked away towards deep square leg to cross over.
Length ball, around off. De Kock clips it across the line, towards mid on.
Good length ball, a touch outside off. De Kock times it well, but straight to point.
Starts off with a length delivery, around off. Defended by de Kock.
Mohammad Hasnain to bowl from the other end!
FOUR! Shot! A good way to get going! Short and wide outside off. Markram stands tall and cuts it to the point fence. 5 from the first over.
Serves a length ball, outside off and Markram leaves it.
Beauty! A brave leave from Markram! Length ball, just outside off. It nips back in and goes over the stumps as Markram leaves it. It was left on length.
Good length delivery, lands a touch outside off and angles away from Markram. He leaves it alone.
Hits the length this time, lands on middle and angles back in. Clipped to fine leg for a single. De Kock and South Africa are off the mark.
Starts off with a back of a length ball, wide outside off. De Kock pushes it to covers.

We are all set for the action to begin then! The Pakistan players are out in the middle and so are the South African openers, de Kock and Aiden Markram. Shaheen Afridi will start proceedings for the visitors with the first new ball. Here we go...

SOUTH AFRICA (UNCHANGED PLAYING XI) - Quinton de Kock (WK), Aiden Markram, Temba Bavuma (C), Rassie van der Dussen, Heinrich Klaasen, David Miller, Andile Phehlukwayo, Kagiso Rabada, Anrich Nortje, Lungi Ngidi, Tabraiz Shamsi.
PAKISTAN (UNCHANGED PLAYING XI) - Fakhar Zaman, Imam-ul-Haq, Babar Azam (C), Mohammad Rizwan (WK), Danish Aziz, Asif Ali, Shadab Khan, Faheem Ashraf, Shaheen Afridi, Mohammad Hasnain, Haris Rauf.
TOSS - PAKISTAN HAVE WON THE TOSS AND ELECTED TO FIELD!

We had an absolute nail-biter the last time these two teams clashed and this could be another cracker! Pakistan would look to continue their winning momentum and go 2-0 in the series. South Africa, on the other hand, will look to cross the line this time and make the last game a decider. Who will come out on top at the end of 100 overs? Your guess is as good as ours! With that, we welcome you to our coverage of the Second ODI between South Africa and Pakistan which is to be played at Johannesburg!
